newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share market dull, block deals dominate.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share market dull, block deals dominate.

text.p: The Singapore stock market was flat in quiet morning trade on Wednesday with blocked deals featuring prominantly among the actives, dealers said.
"The market is quiet. Most of the actives are blocked deals," said a dealer at a local bank-backed brokerage.

At 0230 GMT, the Straits Times Industrials Index was up 3.97 points at 2,120.01. The UOB OTC Index which tracks mainly Malaysian stocks was flat, at 1,184.16. Market volume was light at 17.0 million, with gainers leading losers at 78 to 68.
Topping the actives were Nippecraft Ltd and Malaysian Innovest with 1.4 million and 1.1 million shares respectively.
OCBC Foreign also topped the actives with 978,000 traded, including 518,000 shares crossed at Singapore $16.14-16.21. (US$11.45-11.50)
Keppel Corp and Total Access led gainers, rising S$0.20 and S$0.15 respectively.
Dealers said although the U.S. semi-conductor industry reported an improvement in the book-to-bill ratio in September, there was no impact on Singapore electronic counters.

"Electronic counters remain dull. The August industrial output showed continued slowdown in the sector and that is what the market here is concerned about," a dealer said. The SES Electronic Index was flat at 78.93.
